mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% (historical threshold), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by >0.5% month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals a weak labor market, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 signals economic contraction, which increases recession fears and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1200) indicate strong residential demand, which signals a robust economy and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weak labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE is above 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
